acceptance_tests.name: no_text_leakage
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: leakage scan passes (no question/key text committed)

acceptance_tests.name: abstention_majority_plausible
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: derivable rows all cite an existing repo path

adversarial.expectation: a vocabulary-meaning question must ABSTAIN (no repo authority determines a lesson-vocabulary gloss; guard og-5)

positive.expectation: a pure paradigm question (e.g. form a sound feminine plural) derives its key from sarf/rules with the file cited

candidate_population.selection_rule: all quiz questions (census); derivation only where authority exists

commands.expect: per-question disposition rows; abstention is the default
commands.purpose: for each quiz question (read in PRIVATE custody), attempt an authority-cited derivation; abstain otherwise
commands.run: python - (private-corpus step: emit {question_ref(hash), derivable: bool, authority_path, key_class} — never the question text or the key text for underivable rows)

defeaters: a produced row conflicts with a repo-certified fact -> record as contradicted, do not overwrite
the private corpus is unavailable -> metadata-only steps proceed; body-reading steps abort cleanly

conditions: any key would require a linguistic ruling not in repo authority
escalation_trigger.route: Sol integration review -> owner adjudication where a rule/status change is implied

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: never invent an example, answer key or analysis the source or an independent authority does not support; abstain and record the gap
evidence_policy.statement: evidence level: curriculum-source-supported (uncertified); every row cites its claim-ledger claim_id and manifest file_id (source + claim identity); lesson prose is read in private custody and never committed; committed rows are original restatements

expected_outputs.description: disposition per question (hash-referenced; no question text)

guards: the METHOD transfers, linguistic conclusions never do: a lesson-derived pattern licenses a candidate row, never a resolved analysis at any occurrence
rival-analysis handling: any item admitting more than one admissible analysis is recorded with ALL alternatives (analysis-dependent / school-dependent), never side-picked
no candidate-to-certified automatic promotion: nothing this packet produces may carry status certified; only tools/certify_typed_fact.py certifies, after review, outside this packet

non_deployment.statement: All outputs are candidate-plane repo artifacts; no live surface, entry store, or public payload is touched; deployment is owner-gated elsewhere.

out_of_scope: using keyed questions as independent evaluation
deriving keys from lesson prose alone (answer-visible leakage + rights boundary)
scope.summary: The source publishes 3,096 quiz questions with NO answer key. Keys may NOT be manufactured by model confidence. This packet defines the only permitted path: derive candidate keys ONLY where a committed repo authority (rule file, paradigm table, certified fact) independently determines the answer; every derived key cites that authority; everything else stays keyless. Runs under certifier class because key acceptance is an evidence decision.

title: Review-gated derivation of answer keys for the 3,096 keyless quiz questions
tools_required: the PRIVATE lesson corpus (owner custody) for any step that reads lesson bodies; metadata-only steps run from committed artifacts
